_comment: KHANDAQ (re-review 2026-08-22, KQ-06) — accepted dependency advisories, each with an owner, an
exploitability note and an expiry, as the review requires. scripts/check-vulnerable-deps.py
reads this; an expired entry, or one missing any of those three fields, fails the build.
Two shapes. `waivers` covers one advisory against one package. `scope_waivers` covers a class of
findings — used where the argument is about the CLASS rather than about each advisory, so that
the next advisory against the same build-time library does not arrive as a red build carrying no
new information.
native_waivers — то же самое для вендоренных C-библиотек, которые OSV не индексирует; их
спрашивает scripts/check-native-advisories.py у NVD по CPE. До 22.08.2026 этот слой не
проверялся ничем, и первый же прогон нашёл 114 advisory, включая критическую CVE-2024-5197 в
libvpx 1.8.0, который едет в каждом APK. Даты по Android намеренно короче остальных.
2026-11-10, renewal (Claude on the repository owner's instruction). Everything that expired on
2026-11-19/20 was renewed: versions and build flags are unchanged since the August review, the Qt 6
/ OpenSSL 3 migration is still at the scoping stage, and check-ffmpeg-surface.py passes on the
release slices pinned in nativelibs/SHA256SUMS.txt. Desktop and build-only entries now run to
2027-02-08 (the 90-day limit of the bundled-deps EOL waivers they share a cause with); Android to
2027-01-11, kept shorter as above. The rubyzip waiver was closed instead of renewed: fastlane
2.241.2 accepts rubyzip 3.x, and the lockfile now has 3.7.0. 58 native advisories that NVD attached
to openssl 1.1.1w, ffmpeg 4.4.8/6.0 and libexpat 2.8.3 since August (seven are 2024-2025 CVEs that
the August scan did not get for 1.1.1w; NVD updated them on 2026-11-06..09) were triaged one by one
and added below. None corrupts memory in the messenger; the paragraph below corrects what this
one said about CVE-2026-35189.
2026-11-13, re-check (Claude; the repository owner delegated the decision that day). All 60
entries marked "owner to confirm" were checked again against the shipped binaries (nm on the
pinned Android slices, the v0.2.47 Windows DLLs), the FFmpeg/OpenSSL/expat sources and NVD.
Every conclusion held; some texts did not. CVE-2026-35189 is NOT reachable: Windows release
builds open no TLS connection at all (UPDATE_CHECK=OFF compiles updatecheck.cpp out, and
BootstrapNodeUpdater's HTTPS fetch was removed), so the 13 OpenSSL texts no longer speak of
background HTTPS requests. The Android FFmpeg texts claimed check-ffmpeg-surface.py fails the
build; it ran only on checkouts without the .so, so release-provenance.yml now runs it on the
release slices and it also holds parsers and bitstream filters. libexpat moved to 2.10.0, which
fixes all seven of its advisories, and those entries were removed. CVE-2025-9231/9232 do not
affect 1.1.1 at all (OpenSSL advisory of 2025-09-30); NVD's range is wider than the advisory. NVD
attached CVE-2024-5535 (SSL_select_next_proto over-read) to 1.1.1w on 2026-11-10; it is
waived on the same ground as the other OpenSSL entries: release builds make no TLS connection.
libexif moved to 0.6.26 (2026-04-14), which fixes CVE-2026-32775, -40385 and -40386: all
three sit in MakerNote decoding, which the desktop runs on every received image it
previews (src/widget/imagepreviewwidget.cpp), so they were reachable with one accepted
file. Their waivers are removed rather than kept until the Qt 6 migration.
bcprov-jdk18on, which Robolectric brings to the JVM unit tests, is constrained to 1.85,
the release that fixes GHSA-574f-3g2m-x479 and GHSA-9pwp-9qqc-pr26; both entries are
removed. witness.gradle took exactly that one line from witness-checksums-update.yml
(run 43401422094), and the jar fetched separately from Maven Central has the same sha256.

waivers.exploitability: Build machine only. activesupport is in khandaq-ios/Gemfile.lock because cocoapods-core 1.16.2 needs it for `pod install` on the release Mac; it is not part of the iOS app or any other shipped artifact. The flaw needs untrusted input to reach ActiveSupport::Inflector#safe_constantize, which in practice means a Rails server with Action Cable. Nothing in the build runs Rails or Action Cable, and CocoaPods and fastlane look up only names from our own Podfile, podspecs and Fastfile. The fix exists only in activesupport 8.0.5.2 and 8.1.4.1, and cocoapods-core 1.16.2 requires activesupport < 8, so it cannot be taken without a newer CocoaPods. Revisit when CocoaPods allows activesupport 8. Assessed by Claude (AI assistant) on the repository owner's instruction of 2026-11-12; the owner, told the same day that it awaited confirmation, asked for it to be closed as written.

build-only.exploitability: Не попадает пользователю. Это артефакты, которые витнесс-файл закрепляет для аннотейшн-процессоров, линта и тестовых раннеров; в releaseRuntimeClasspath их нет, значит в APK они не входят (проверено: sbom/android-release-runtime.txt, guava в поставке 33.0.0-android — без advisory). Остаточный риск — компрометация цепочки сборки, а не устройства пользователя; его закрывают закреплённые sha256 в witness.gradle и провенанс SLSA на релизной сборке.
build-only.review_note: Снимать вместе с обновлением инструментов сборки в том же цикле, что и K-04 (Qt 6 / OpenSSL 3, waiver до 2027-02-08) — оба про поддерживаемость, и держать их на разных датах смысла нет.
build-only.packages_note: Перечень закрыт намеренно: область покрывает ТОЛЬКО эти артефакты и только ниже CRITICAL. Новый пакет или критическая advisory обязаны пройти разбор поимённо — именно так всплыла GHSA-574f-3g2m-x479, которую прежний blanket-waiver проглотил бы молча.

ЭНКОДЕР VP9, не декодер. NVD: «mishandles widths, leading to a crash related to encoding». Достижимо только тем, кто задаёт размеры кодируемого кадра. В Khandaq они приходят с локальной камеры: toxav_video_send_frame(av, call, frame.width, frame.height, …) вызывается клиентом (coreav.cpp:429), а энкодер переконфигурируется под эти же размеры перед кодированием (toxav.c:1607). Удалённый собеседник на них не влияет. Тот же класс, что CVE-2023-5217, которая по этой же причине намеренно не бэкпортируется. Пересмотреть, если появится путь, где размеры кодирования задаются удалённой стороной.

ЭНКОДЕР VP8: переполнение кучи при смене конфигурации посреди кодирования. Энкодер toxav работает по локально заданной конфигурации, удалённый собеседник её не задаёт. Осознанно НЕ бэкпортируется — правка энкодера добавила бы риск без выигрыша; аргумент записан в circle_scripts/deps.sh.

ЭНКОДЕР VP9, не декодер. Описание: «Encoding a frame that has larger dimensions than the originally configured size with VP9 may result in a heap overflow». В Khandaq энкодер переконфигурируется под размеры каждого отправляемого кадра до кодирования, а сами размеры берутся с локального захвата, поэтому состояние «кадр больше сконфигурированного» не возникает и не задаётся снаружи. См. разбор в CVE-2023-44488.

build_only_reviewed.rationale: Server-side flaw: SslClientHelloHandler falls back to the default SslContext on a fragmented ClientHello, which bypasses mTLS only where per-SNI SslContext selection is the sole gate and the default context is more permissive; fixed in 4.1.137.Final. Netty 4.1.93.Final comes from grpc-netty 1.57.0, pulled in by the Android Gradle Plugin 8.6.0 and its Unified Test Platform artifacts (com.android.tools.utp 31.6.0), which run only for connected (instrumented) tests; CI runs none. The UTP plugins use it as gRPC clients, and AGP's own result-listener server (UtpTestResultListenerServer) uses a single SslContext with clientAuth=REQUIRE and no SNI routing, so there is no fallback to bypass. It is not in releaseRuntimeClasspath (sbom/android-release-runtime.txt has no netty or grpc artifact), so it never ships in the APK. There is no plain version bump: the Netty version follows AGP's grpc. Residual risk is limited to the build environment.
